latest_release.body:
# Notes
- **Deprecation of 32-bit platforms:** Running Zigbee2MQTT on 32-bit platforms is deprecated, and support ends when Node.js 22 reaches end-of-life (April 2027). At that point the minimum supported Node.js version becomes v24, and Node.js v24 no longer ships official builds for any 32-bit platform. This affects every installation method (Docker, bare-metal/Linux, etc.). For Docker the 32-bit Docker images (`linux/386`, `linux/arm/v6` and `linux/arm/v7`) will not be updated anymore, and non-Docker installs on a 32-bit OS will no longer be able to run a supported Node.js version. If you run Zigbee2MQTT on 32-bit hardware or a 32-bit OS (e.g. Raspberry Pi 1/Zero, older Raspberry Pi OS 32-bit installs), plan to move to a 64-bit OS or hardware (`amd64`/`x86_64`, `arm64`/`aarch64`) before then. (https://github.com/Koenkk/zigbee2mqtt/issues/33552).

# Improvements

- [#13615](https://github.com/Koenkk/zigbee-herdsman-converters/issues/13615) Onokom air conditioners: expose external temperature sensor controls (@zwg3)
- [#13562](https://github.com/Koenkk/zigbee-herdsman-converters/issues/13562) Acova ALCANTARA3: report apparent power and support accurate system mode selection (@maxiiss)
- [#13555](https://github.com/Koenkk/zigbee-herdsman-converters/issues/13555) AVATTO TS0601_thermostat_14: expose `system_mode` and `frost_protection_temperature` (@giogandola98)
- [#13580](https://github.com/Koenkk/zigbee-herdsman-converters/issues/13580) Danfoss Ally eTRV0103: expose heating system mode and minimum temperature limits (@Retr0Joe)
- [#13573](https://github.com/Koenkk/zigbee-herdsman-converters/issues/13573) Sinopé TH1500ZB: expose power and energy measurements (@timoshawn)
- [#13566](https://github.com/Koenkk/zigbee-herdsman-converters/issues/13566) SONOFF MINI-ZB1GSP: expose `frequency`, `today_runtime` and `lifetime` (@CubeZ2mDeveloper)
- [#13565](https://github.com/Koenkk/zigbee-herdsman-converters/issues/13565) SONOFF SNZB-02UL: allow periodic weather updates and apply selected icons immediately (@CubeZ2mDeveloper)

- [#13476](https://github.com/Koenkk/zigbee-herdsman-converters/issues/13476) Calc precision and check min/max/resolution values in generateDefinition (@luar123)
- [#13491](https://github.com/Koenkk/zigbee-herdsman-converters/issues/13491) Lidl HG06620: expose countdown timer and allow firmware updates (@uluckas)
- [#13499](https://github.com/Koenkk/zigbee-herdsman-converters/issues/13499) MultIR MIR-SR100: expose configurable `warning` settings (@LotusRou)
- [#13496](https://github.com/Koenkk/zigbee-herdsman-converters/issues/13496) Schneider Electric MEG5779: expose `window_open` (@l-naumann)
